shorts_extract.hook: Why two honest people remember the exact same fight in opposite ways.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Loftus & Palmer (1974) car-crash verb swap + Loftus & Pickrell (1995) Lost-in-the-Mall implantation.
shorts_extract.twist: 25% remembered a fake childhood mall crisis, and 2016-2018 fMRI proved the hippocampus edits memories to help us imagine tomorrow.
